headline: Headline GPU indexes held flat week-on-week, but marketplace prices fell for H100 SXM, B200 and L40S.
bullets: H100 SXM's market index held at $4.62 (+0%) while its marketplace median dropped -17% to $2.21, with Vast.ai cheapest at $1.73.
B200's index stayed at $8.50 (+0%) as its marketplace median slipped -8% to $7.36, while the hyperscaler median of $14.12 sits +77% above the neocloud median of $7.99.
L40S marketplace pricing fell -7% to $0.74 even as its hyperscaler median edged +1% to $3.14, while A100 80GB SXM marketplace pricing rose +3% to $1.31.
H100 PCIe offers the best price-performance of all 11 tracked GPUs at $3.60 per PFLOP-hour, with MI300X close behind at $3.62 among the headline GPUs.
H100 NVL carries the widest hyperscaler premium across tracked GPUs at +184%, ahead of H100 SXM at +140% among the headline GPUs.
watch: Whether the -17% H100 SXM marketplace drop starts pulling down its $4.45 neocloud median, which was unchanged at +0% this week.
